key_insight: Growing Harness converts repeated agent control decisions from per-task prompt context into reusable executable code that improves as tasks provide feedback.
engineering_relevance: This enables lower-cost, more reliable LLM agents by shrinking inference calls and preserving task-solving behavior across model sizes.
method: Start from a strategy-free scaffold with fixed model/tool interfaces but no built-in controller.
Use function-level execution traces to localize failures, then repair a bounded code window jointly.
Apply a success-first held-out gate to roll back edits that hurt previously learned capability.
evidence_signal: Across BrowseComp-Plus and WebArena-Verified with 4B to 120B deployment models, it achieved the best mean success in five of six settings and cut LLM calls by 76.0–91.8%.
watch_item: Because harness behavior is learned through iterative edits and rollback, the approach may require careful trace coverage and gate design to avoid regressions or unstable code growth.
paper_title: Grow the Harness, Not the Context: From Strategy-Free Scaffolds to Reusable Specialist Agents
